exit_criteria.text: Phase timing includes synchronous-ready work and the final event-loop gap, with a failing-before control for both blind spots.
The real network-isolated Mac composition measures visible large-file navigation, drawer, theme and fallback interactions while preserving exact source and cache assertions.

An exact-candidate report distinguishes measured results, enforceable justified budgets, known input-budget failures and unmeasured platforms or launch/active-work gaps; BPR-0967 remains open when broader acceptance is missing.
Attribute the baseline metadata/load, first-source and revisit stalls with exact public-course observations.
Repair justified owning-boundary causes with failing-before controls and affected composed verification, without raising existing thresholds; retain exact diagnosis for any unresolved gap.
Record exact candidate, unchanged cache/source/cleanup invariants, command quiescence and remaining acceptance in a durable coordinator handoff.
Inventory actual process, QApplication, composition, fixture-connect, metadata, Git-ready and rendered-frame boundaries on the exact safe Mac candidate.
Exercise the shipped public fixture selection and a supported fixture control under enforced network denial; do not add a production fixture or substitute QWidget capture for compositor presentation.

If true launch is safely observable, record exact hardware/toolkit/candidate and justified launch/metadata/render budgets; otherwise record the demonstrated limitation, keep these criteria pending and stop at the assigned partial boundary.
Preserve the 100 ms input target, prior exact source/cache/history and lifetime-peak evidence, protected RFC0052 session, all other worktrees and every outstanding platform or acceptance obligation.

Exercise public input and supersession or cancellation during observed outstanding work in the safe network-isolated Mac composition, recording precise endpoints and sampled job identities/counts without inferring continuous CPU occupancy.
Preserve exact source, authority, anchors, epoch and cache assertions; any repair has a failing-before control and focused verification against the exact candidate.

Justify any new completion bounds from measured work while keeping the 100 ms input target and prior 108.139 ms initial-load miss explicit; finish independent unattended work and report remaining active-work coverage honestly.
Resolve the unchanged 100 ms initial-load input miss with owning-boundary controls and exact public verification, or preserve a demonstrated external limitation; do not stop at a constituent commit.

Measure process-entry/QApplication and provisional versus accepted metadata and rendered-widget boundaries through the existing safe composition; distinguish any unavailable production/native compositor endpoint explicitly.
Exercise generated and pathological fallback with preserved source/metadata identity and exact recovery, measured completion/input budgets, and controls that fail when fallback or recovery is false.

Measure peak live heap with a declared observation method and justified budget where safely supported, classify unobserved intervals or instrumentation effects honestly, and reconcile all Mac dimensions plus deferred platform/native decisions in one durable handoff.

User correction: use optimized Release measurements, matching the Mac production compiler optimization and deployment policy, for performance acceptance and budget justification. Preserve Debug runs only as diagnostic/correctness evidence. Repeat representative responsiveness/resource/launch/metadata/generated/active-work courses on the exact optimized candidate; document fixture/distribution and native/compositor differences and any concrete build or execution blocker.
